facts: FI paged_kv_t has independent K/V strides; kernels use separate compile-time QK/VO dimensions.

FI default Params lack v_scale but original AttentionVariantBase detects a typed Params v_scale member and applies it in OutputTransform before output cast. Reuse a private derived Params; no vendor patch or separate post-output scaling is required by the planned route. Split-KV qualification remains required.
FI FP8 prefill repacks individual shared-memory tiles for selected dimensions; this is bounded per-CTA staging, not full-history KV decoding.
CPU Q8 attention quantizes Q to the K vec_dot type and uses per-row V conversion. Oracle must account for the extra Q conversion.
GGML Metal may reserve full F16 K/V even when the direct vector path is selected. The planned Apple carrier uses the original MLX execution owner and tile loads, not this GGML Metal path.
GGML Vulkan full-KV dequant branch is incompatible with the selected direct compressed paged contract; qualify and bypass it for the explicit HYLE paged operation.
Q8_0 has 32 codes and inline F16 scale in 34 bytes. Reference absmax/127 and roundf are explicit; optimized quantizer tie differences cannot be silently asserted byte-identical.
